selectionRepairs.reason: Actual robotics uses linear algebra; Mathematical Methods supplies calculus rather than vectors/matrices.
Poetry/performance does not establish claimed industrial visualisation. Behavioural experiments specifically support customer choice and adoption.
Partner research is offered only in semester1, before useful foundations. Actual renewable-resource/conversion experiments can follow the sustainability gateway and support later energy assessment.

stopping: Two alternatives retained after evidence, coherence, qualitative/numerical distinctness and feasibility. Health, mobility and digital-interaction candidates assessed separately and rejected on their actual design contributions; no quota or default third alternative.
